name: CALVADOS 2 single-chain conformational model of the retained 5' partner segments

known_answer_control.description: Two-sided and both prespecified. (1) The CALVADOS package's OWN shipped single-IDR example is reproduced end to end on the same install and its nu must land in the physical range - the only step separating 'the instrument works' from 'our wrapper does something and nobody checked'. (2) Directional: EWSR1 1-264 with 15% of positions substituted to Glu must EXPAND relative to the parent, because like charges repel under the model's Debye-Huckel term. Failing (2) withholds every nu.
known_answer_control.note: BOTH CONTROLS RETURNED 2026-08-24 and both passed. (1) The package's shipped single-IDR example reproduced end to end on the same install. (2) The directional control moved nu by 0.082 against a prespecified separation threshold of 0.057, so the model resolves a difference of that size when one is present. ⛔ THE CONTROLS PASSING IS WHAT MAKES THE NULL ADMISSIBLE, AND IT IS NOT A LICENCE TO QUOTE THE NULL AS A PROOF OF IDENTITY. The run did NOT meet its own prespecified convergence criterion — about a quarter of runs drift by more than the pooled replicate spread — so every value is provisional, and the arm excludes only partner differences larger than about 0.06 in nu. ⭐ The noise floor is confirmed by a second route: two runs of the same construct with the SAME seed on different machines differ by 0.022, about one pooled SD, because the CPU platform is not bit-reproducible across hosts.

scope_note: Reads one single-chain conformational observable - the Flory scaling exponent nu - for the retained N-terminal segments of EMC's reported 5' partners, each length-matched to a TCF12 window so chain length is not the between-partner variable. ⛔ It does NOT measure a saturation concentration, a phase diagram or condensate formation; the link from single-chain properties to phase behaviour is the MODEL's premise, not this instrument's measurement. ⚠ The commonest reported junction retains EWSR1 1-431 while this repository's AlphaFold assessment puts the folded RRM at 361-442, so the type-1 window is truncated before the RRM and the multi-domain reading is out of scope. The slab phase-coexistence arm - the one that would make 'phase behaviour' a measurement rather than a premise - needs a GPU and is not authorised. MEASURED RESULT 2026-08-24: a null on every prespecified comparison — no partner window separates from any other, and none separates from wild-type NR4A3's own disordered region. One home for the numbers: emc-condensate-calvados-findings.md.
closure_note: SHELVED 2026-08-24 BY DECISION (trimcrae: "it sounds like this is all chasing"). ⛔ THE INSTRUMENT IS NOT BROKEN AND THE ARM IS NOT UNFINISHED. It ran to its prespecified standard, both controls passed, and it answered: a bounded null on every prespecified comparison. What closes it is RESOLUTION, not failure -- it excludes partner differences larger than about 0.06 in nu and cannot speak to smaller ones, and the run did not meet its own convergence criterion, so every value is provisional. ⛔ Extending this arm with more sampling is forbidden by its own prespecification and is NOT the way to reopen it. The multi-chain coexistence arm that could go finer is GPU-only (measured: under 5 integration steps per second on CPU against the ~150 million the standard protocol needs) and was priced at tens of dollars but declined on expected value, because the cheap correlated readout had already come back empty.
